I posted the answer in the #coastal-team thread for Kwame.

The official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics was November 3, 2025. Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2, 2025 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's Dec 8 cutover recap also calls Nov 3 the official handoff.

The same recap says Bettina kept running the account day to day through Nov 21 and that Kwame fully took over on Nov 22, 2025. I told him to use Nov 3 for "officially changed hands" in the CRM, and Nov 22 if the field is for when he started running it.
